text: Fix two bugs in 'athena land --pr' (crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs and its caller). First, the pull request's base must be the repository's default branch on the remote (as GitHub reports it), not the current local branch; today a local branch that is not on the remote makes GitHub answer HTTP 422. Second, the pushed work branch must carry the whole job, including its verification, outcome and other records, not only the candidate commit, so that merging the PR lands everything 'athena check --history' expects on main. Add tests for both. Keep merging behind the existing off-by-default opt-in.
